turns.prompt: Create a short root `AGENTS.md` for this repository.

criteria.c1: Creates a complete root `AGENTS.md` for Acme Status Bot.
criteria.c2: Includes a shared-rules or skill-reference section that points to the installed `agent-doc-rules` guidance, including `.agents/skills/agent-doc-rules/references/agents-rules.md`.
criteria.c3: Includes local rules from the project README: English persisted artifacts, read-only first phase, and no secrets/customer identifiers.
criteria.c5: Includes verification guidance for `npm test` and documenting residual risk when tests cannot run.
criteria.c6: Does not copy the full shared rules into the project `AGENTS.md`.
criteria.c7: Does not invent tools, cloud providers, issue workflows, optional skills, Notion usage, worktrees, or task-manager commands.
criteria.c8: Is concise and suitable as always-loaded agent instructions.
